1.3 Evidence classes

ClassMeaning
SIMmodel run (CFD, FE, Monte Carlo, quasi-1D, CEA, SIL)
CALChand calculation on model loads or standard geometry
DERIVEDcomputed from other traced values (by a specialist, a reviewer or this generator)
ASSUMEDan input adopted without a measurement or a source
DATASHEETmaker data
LITERATUREpublished data, cited
AS RECALLEDa value quoted from memory by its author; to be sourced
TO-VERIFYneeded from, or to be confirmed by, the named owner
MISSINGnot available; never estimated by the generator
ESTIMATEan estimate named as such by its source
DECIDEDa design value, decided limit or requirement: chosen, not measured or computed; where the source gives a basis, that basis and its tag are shown beside it (source class: design value, lead decision line N, or requirement)
REFa reference or provenance text (a source, a review id, a "no number changed" statement): it carries no value and no pill
PENDINGan input that has not landed (never assumed)
SUPERSEDEDwithdrawn by a newer decision, shown only as history
TO-DEFINEnot yet defined by its owner (the value is MISSING)

Every number carries one of the ten evidence tags (SIM, CALC, DERIVED, ASSUMED, DATASHEET, LITERATURE, AS RECALLED, TO-VERIFY, MISSING, ESTIMATE) or the source-class pill DECIDED. The tag comes from the source tag or the quoted text; where neither gives one, the trace names the class set at the call site. This generator sets no default class: a value without a class is counted as UNTAGGED in qa_report. A lead line that quotes a SIM, DERIVED or CALC number keeps that number's tag; DECIDED applies only to the chosen value itself. PENDING, SUPERSEDED and TO-DEFINE are statuses shown beside the tag. A review verdict, a matching number or a passing check is not physical approval.

PURGE (A1 relight only)−2.900 s DERIVEDLead decision, line 153T1309PURGE commits iff the lead to the plain relight trigger is >= L* = 1.3 s (LEAD 186 (1), ADOPTED for both wall heat-transfer brackets; replaces the 1.7 s interim of 181 (2) and the PROVISIONAL rule of 175 (3)); below L* no purge and no unpurged relight on that pass (drogue descent; vehicle loss in the FMEA); the ECU unpurged RELIGHT guard enforces it (LEAD 203 (7), v2.11). 8.3 Afterburning and model limits

Afterburning by operating point (RPL §0) and the model limits (RPL §10); operating points in Table 8.0.
ItemReport statement
Afterburning at the v1 point (O/F 7.76)adds 172-182 K at O/F 7.76 (temporal band 172-178 K; time-matched fine maximum 179.2 K; Richardson extrapolation of the three levels 181.8 K); SIMT1607
Afterburning at the v2 point (O/F 10.435; the current max-thrust point when Table 8.0 says so)adds nothing at the v2 point for an equilibrium exhaust (O/F 10.4, oxidiser-rich; 0.44 K). The stream-B upper bound, which releases the c* deficit by fast chemistry, raises the plume maximum from 2705 K to 3011 K at that point (difference of maxima, +306 K; ownruns/c_2s_100_v2op/fig/c2s_v2op_afterburn_stats.json); SIMT1608
Afterburning at the stretch floor (12.5 %)adds up to 1476 K at the fuel-rich 12.5 % floor. SIMT1609
Limit: Soot and radiationSoot and radiation. There is no soot model and no radiative transfer. The synthetic photo uses an ASSUMED soot proxy. SIMT1610
Limit: Finite-rate chemistryFinite-rate chemistry and turbulence-chemistry interaction. Afterburning is a fast-chemistry, mean-Z equilibrium bound. Real afterburning is lower, and possibly zero if the mixture quenches. SIMT1611
Limit: Exhaust gas modelExhaust gas model. The exhaust is a calorically perfect gas with frozen calibrated gamma, which gives core temperature errors up to about -500/+30 K in the strongly expanded region (§4). SIMT1612
Limit: Geometry and settingGeometry and setting. The model is axisymmetric only (no gimbal angle, no 3-D structure) and has no ground plane, so no landing impingement or recirculation is modelled. SIMT1613
Limit: DurationDuration. Simulated time is 3-4 ms. The far field (> 15 De) is not statistically stationary, and the fine level covers only 0.25 ms. SIMT1614
Limit: No acousticsNo acoustics or plume loads on the vehicle. SIMT1615

The unlit cold-flow rise is about 0.42 bar, about 0.38 bar short of the 0.80 bar E2 rise, which an error of about 15 K at k = 1 or 5 K at k = 3 closes [DERIVED]; 13 of 44 unlit relight runs reach FALSE_E2 and 33 of 64 lit runs lose the relight; at A1 k = 3 with a -30 K error the gnc v3.2 release predicate holds from the false E2 and run-lift flow enters the unlit chamber for 280 ms (a drogue release with no thrust; the FC is not modelled). Credible causes: spark-coupled interference on the grounded-junction TC at the C1 boss, a lead short, a MAX31856 conversion error. DECIDEDLead decision, line 266 (5)T032

E4-01, the MAJOR finding (266 (5))
E4-01 (MAJOR) [SIM reviewer SIL variant; CALC probes]: with option (b) the seat compensation acts in every state, is not frozen in the light window and has no TC4 step or rate check, so a TC4 reading error after E1 gives a false or premature E2 at every start. The unlit cold-flow rise is about 0.42 bar, about 0.38 bar short of the 0.80 bar E2 rise, which an error of about 15 K at k = 1 or 5 K at k = 3 closes [DERIVED]; 13 of 44 unlit relight runs reach FALSE_E2 and 33 of 64 lit runs lose the relight; at A1 k = 3 with a -30 K error the gnc v3.2 release predicate holds from the false E2 and run-lift flow enters the unlit chamber for 280 ms (a drogue release with no thrust; the FC is not modelled). Credible causes: spark-coupled interference on the grounded-junction TC at the C1 boss, a lead short, a MAX31856 conversion error. DECIDEDLead decision, line 266 (5)T032

J-F1b: 175 C peak with the dwell (method TO-DEFINE)
J-F1b (the optional J-F1 extension of hardware v1.7 HW-101; rule lead 19:53:27Z, PEAK 175 C ACCEPTED 21:17:03Z, dwell CORRECTED, CHANGELOG 248 (7); work-tree record jf1b_loctite_v352_v1.json 2ba9d10745f3f651, read-only [SIM]): 5 of the J-F1 joints (with the spring, the load washer kept in; J-F1 coupons, never flight hardware), the cycle 20 -> 175 C -> 20 C, at least 10 min at the peak from when the spring flat reaches the peak, 10 cycles as in hardware v1.7, residual preload and breakaway torque recorded after each cycle as data for the preload-retention audit (the check on the relaxation model). Peak 175 C = max(160 C, the governing SOAK70 zone maximum 160.29 C + 10 C) rounded up to 5 C (the js5 screw set alone gives 170 C, information); the 10 min is more than ten times the governing state's 53.0 s above (zone maximum - 10 C). METHOD: a uniform oven cycle puts the tap LOCTITE 243 at 175 C against 97.7 C in service, so it is allowed only once Henkel's service range for 243 is verified to cover 175 C (AS RECALLED -55 to +180 C, TO-VERIFY); otherwise the spring and head zone are heated locally and the tap temperature is recorded; TO-DEFINE by the test owner (founder). Post-abort joint replacement rule
(4) POST-ABORT RULE (founder rule, lead 248 (7)): after any case-TC or TB-state abort the J-FWD joint counts as used: the ten ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws and their HW-170 springs are replaced (new, single-use) and the TC-01 holes (pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62) and the TC-02 taps (M5-6H GO / NO-GO) are gauged before the next run. TB-state aborts (CONFIRMED by Mechanical on the lead's provisional set of 253 (8), lc_tb70_envelope_v2.json F4_abort_set): HW_OVERPRESSURE, PC_OVERPRESSURE, HARD_START and PC_SENSOR on the HIGH side (transducer output >= 4.75 V = 146.5 bar abs), with the case-TC OVER_TEMP abort of F-14. Reason: the post-abort soak (ASSUMED shifted history, J-FWD band up to 201.4 C GVLO / 164.0 C GVHI, jf1b_loctite_v352_v1.json) is not a rows or J-F1b state. BESIDE IT, for every run whatever its end (ridden-through FA-1 pulses included), the J-FWD REPLACE RULE of the LC-TB70 envelope v2 (lc_tb70_envelope_v2.json 7ebd2fd63dc878ef; it supersedes v1's 'any head excursion above 60.0 bar abs'): when Q_JFWD exceeds 60.0 bar abs at any time in a run (Q_JFWD = the larger of the head-end peak and the head-end undamped SDOF ESP at the J-FWD periods 0.2-0.5 ms, on the light window and on each excursion window; no minimum duration) the joint counts as used: before the next run the line-231 J-FWD inspection (C6 (2) list) and the TC-02 taps gauged (M5-6H GO / NO-GO). Appendix A Value trace

Every traced value used in this document: trace id, value (a value read from a source at the precision of that source; a value the generator computes, to 6 significant digits; the body may show it rounded), class, source and version, key (JSON pointer, markdown row, CHANGELOG line and item, or generator formula) and the source tag text. A DECIDED value also shows its source class (design value, lead decision or requirement). Identical source keys share one id. Display rules of the body and of this appendix (trace.json keeps the source strings): the review status written in Spanish in the FEA3D-2 report prints as "to be reviewed" (REV-DS-1 D1-12); a bare "§n" in a combustion.json text prints as "combustion REPORT §n" (D1-11); a number read from a source prints at the precision of that source, and a number read from a text keeps the digits of the text (D1-08).
